newLabels.new:avatar-stack: An overlapping stack of avatar circles with a +N count.
newLabels.new:awkward-number-format: Numbers are formatted inconsistently or with redundant decimals.
newLabels.new:awkward-text-wrap: Labels or names wrap awkwardly in narrow cells.
newLabels.new:broken-images: Small images or icons fail to load and render as dots or blanks.
newLabels.new:card-footer-action-bar: A card ends in a grey footer bar holding Cancel and Save.
newLabels.new:card-header-dividers: Cards have a rule separating the card title from its body.
newLabels.new:centred-fixed-container: Content sits in a narrow centred fixed-width column.
newLabels.new:chart-event-annotation: An event is annotated on the chart with a band or marker line.
newLabels.new:chart-legend-mismatch: The legend or labels don't match the marks drawn (missing series, unlabelled segment).
newLabels.new:chart-table-toggle: A Chart/Table toggle offers the data as a table.
newLabels.new:checkbox-column: Tables lead with a row-selection checkbox column.
newLabels.new:clipped-content: Text, columns or labels are cut off or overflow their container.
newLabels.new:consistent-outline-icons: One outline icon set is used consistently, e.g. beside each detail or in the nav.
newLabels.new:count-beside-search: A result count is floated to the right of the search field.
newLabels.new:cover-photo-profile: A profile page with a landscape cover photo and overlapping round avatar.
newLabels.new:cramped-spacing: Elements are squeezed with too little space between them.
newLabels.new:crowded-axis-labels: An axis labels every tick so the labels crowd each other.
newLabels.new:dark-mode-toggle: A dark-mode button or moon icon sits in the header.
newLabels.new:dated-sample-data: Sample data is visibly old (e.g. 2018 crypto prices, 2014 filenames).
newLabels.new:dated-template-look: The styling reads as an older (2014-era) flat admin template.
newLabels.new:debug-control-exposed: A developer/demo control (e.g. "Make the next change fail") is left in the product UI.
newLabels.new:delta-indicators: Values carry green/red up/down triangles or arrows for change.
newLabels.new:diff-chips: A change log shows old and new values as strikethrough-to-new chips.
newLabels.new:direct-line-labels: Series are labelled at the line ends instead of with a legend.
newLabels.new:disabled-until-valid: The primary action stays disabled until the form is filled in.
newLabels.new:diverse-name-roster: Sample people form a deliberately diverse roster of names.
newLabels.new:domain-expert-copy: Copy uses accurate, specialist domain detail (temperatures, techniques, regional spelling).
newLabels.new:domain-inconsistency: Sample content contradicts itself within the domain (e.g. a braised dish on the grill station).
newLabels.new:domain-specific-structure: Content is structured the way the domain works (e.g. ingredients grouped by stage, quantity-first).
newLabels.new:dot-separated-meta: Metadata items run in a row separated by middle dots.
newLabels.new:dotted-pastel-status-pills: Status shown as tinted pills with a leading coloured dot.
newLabels.new:duplicated-information: The same fact (count, name, date) is shown twice on the screen.
newLabels.new:edge-case-handling: The screen shows copy or states for edge cases (e.g. the sole owner cannot change role).
newLabels.new:ellipsis-placeholder: A search field's placeholder text ends in an ellipsis.
newLabels.new:em-dash-copy: Em dashes appear in names or interface strings.
newLabels.new:every-section-in-card: Every section sits in its own identical rounded bordered card.
newLabels.new:export-option: An Export CSV or similar data-download control sits beside the chart.
newLabels.new:eyebrow-label: A small label sits above the page title.
newLabels.new:file-type-icons: Files are listed with per-type document icons.
newLabels.new:filter-toolbar: A toolbar of filter pills and selects sits above the content.
newLabels.new:fully-ruled-table: A table with borders on every cell.
newLabels.new:generic-product-name: An invented, generic or cute product name (Relay, PawBook).
newLabels.new:generic-subtitle: A generic subtitle restates the page title or task.
newLabels.new:glossy-raised-button: A button is drawn glossy and raised with a heavy bottom shadow or gradient.
newLabels.new:gradient-area-fill: A line chart has a soft gradient or tinted fill beneath the line.
newLabels.new:gradient-logo-mark: The logo is a gradient-filled square mark.
newLabels.new:hairline-row-dividers: Thin hairline rules separate every row of a list.
newLabels.new:headline-not-shown-in-chart: The headline names an event that the chart does not mark.
newLabels.new:helper-text-every-field: Every field has helper text beneath it.
newLabels.new:identical-placeholder-rows: Table rows repeat identical placeholder values (same date, same status, '#' index).
newLabels.new:inconsistent-capitalisation: The same kind of label is capitalised differently from item to item.
newLabels.new:inconsistent-component-styles: One instance of a component is styled unlike its siblings or the rest of the UI.
newLabels.new:inset-shadowed-field: An input is drawn inset with a grey inner shadow, often reading as disabled.
newLabels.new:keyboard-shortcut-hint: A "/" keyboard shortcut hint sits in the search field.
newLabels.new:label-value-grid: Metadata laid out as a uniform grid of grey labels over values.
newLabels.new:letter-logo-tile: The logo is a small square tile with a letter or monogram.
newLabels.new:links-everywhere: Every email, phone or value is rendered as an underlined link.
newLabels.new:literal-icon-logo: The logo is a literal stock icon of the domain (truck, paw, brush).
newLabels.new:locale-number-format: Numbers use a non-local format such as $1.800,00.
newLabels.new:minimal-chrome: Plain pale page with no sidebar and little surrounding interface chrome.
newLabels.new:misaligned-element: An element sits out of alignment with its neighbours.
newLabels.new:monochrome-no-accent: The interface is black, white and grey with no accent colour.
newLabels.new:monospace-ids: Reference IDs are set in a monospace face.
newLabels.new:muted-comparison-series: A prior period is drawn as a muted grey line against an accented current series.
newLabels.new:nested-containers: A table sits in a bordered box inside another card or container.
newLabels.new:no-cards: Content sits flat on the page without card containers.
newLabels.new:odd-copy: A heading or label uses unusual or awkward wording.
newLabels.new:overlapping-text: Two lines of text are drawn on top of each other.
newLabels.new:oversized-numbers: A stat or hero number is set very large.
newLabels.new:page-in-single-card: The whole page's content is wrapped in one large card.
newLabels.new:pastel-tag-chips: Roles, tags or allergens shown as tinted or outlined pill chips.
newLabels.new:pill-nav: Top navigation items are rendered as pills.
newLabels.new:placeholder-contact-details: Contact details use placeholder values such as 555 phone numbers.
newLabels.new:plain-line-chart: A simple single-line chart without decoration.
newLabels.new:primary-secondary-button-pair: A filled primary button sits beside a bordered secondary button.
newLabels.new:progress-bar-every-row: Every table row carries a progress bar with a percentage.
newLabels.new:prose-chart-summary: A caption or subtitle restates the chart's figures in words.
newLabels.new:purposeful-helper-copy: Helper copy explains consequences or context specific to the task.
newLabels.new:quirky-sample-data: Sample data includes quirky or joke names and odd values.
newLabels.new:radio-with-descriptions: Radio options each carry a descriptive helper line.
newLabels.new:rainbow-colour-coding: Avatars or pills are given many arbitrary hues, one per item or status.
newLabels.new:raised-breadcrumb-chips: Breadcrumb or tab items are drawn as raised, shadowed button chips.
newLabels.new:raised-tactile-style: Controls are drawn raised or bevelled, like physical keys.
newLabels.new:ranked-bar-list: A tidy list of horizontal bars ranks items.
newLabels.new:raw-data-leak: Raw data values (e.g. a sparkline's number list) render as visible text.
newLabels.new:raw-float-in-copy: An unrounded floating-point number (28.000000000000004) appears in the interface.
newLabels.new:real-photo-avatars: Avatars are real photographs of people.
newLabels.new:red-overdue-flag: Late or overdue values are flagged in red text.
newLabels.new:relative-timestamps: Times are shown relatively ("2 hours ago").
newLabels.new:rendering-artifacts: Chart marks render with jagged or broken edges.
newLabels.new:restrained-palette: A muted palette with one or two colours and no decoration.
newLabels.new:sample-data-label: A "Sample data" pill badge is shown in the header.
newLabels.new:save-status-indicator: A small "Saved" chip sits beside the primary action.
newLabels.new:segmented-controls: Options are switched with segmented pill controls.
newLabels.new:selected-state-heavy-border: The selected card is marked by a heavy or coloured border.
newLabels.new:sentence-status-line: A result count is written as a full sentence with a full stop.
newLabels.new:serif-display-headings: Headings are set in a serif display face.
newLabels.new:single-chart-focus: One chart carries the whole page instead of a row of KPI cards.
newLabels.new:small-radius-flat-cards: Cards have a small radius, thin borders and no soft shadow.
newLabels.new:smoothed-chart-lines: Line charts use smoothed spline curves between points.
newLabels.new:social-media-widgets: Social follow buttons and circular social-network icons.
newLabels.new:sort-arrows-every-column: Every column header carries a sort arrow.
newLabels.new:sortable-columns: A table column header carries a sort control.
newLabels.new:source-sans-type: The interface is set in Source Sans.
newLabels.new:sparse-axis-ticks: The x-axis shows only a few ticks (e.g. quarterly) instead of every period.
newLabels.new:sparse-dead-space: Most of the page is left empty, with sparse content.
newLabels.new:status-hierarchy-by-fill: Status pills differ by solid, outlined or plain fill to show rank.
newLabels.new:stock-sample-names: Stock or invented sample organisation and people names (Northwind, Acme).
newLabels.new:stock-screen-archetype: The screen follows a textbook template archetype (settings form, projects table, KPI dashboard).
newLabels.new:stock-status-set: Statuses use the stock On track / At risk / Off track set.
newLabels.new:stray-focus-outline: A focus ring is drawn around a non-input element such as the page title or main region.
newLabels.new:stray-separator: A separator dot or bullet trails with nothing after it.
newLabels.new:sync-status-shown: A "Last synced/Updated" time is shown, often with a Refresh button.
newLabels.new:takeaway-chart-title: The chart title states the finding as a sentence.
newLabels.new:template-sample-copy: Lorem/hipster ipsum or template demo copy is left in.
newLabels.new:text-link-tabs: Section navigation is plain underlined text links.
newLabels.new:too-tidy-data: Sample data is suspiciously regular: sequential IDs and uniformly plausible values.
newLabels.new:truncated-axis: The y-axis starts above zero, exaggerating change.
newLabels.new:two-column-form-layout: A form or editor on the left with a narrow details column on the right.
newLabels.new:two-line-cells: Table cells carry a grey secondary line under the main value.
newLabels.new:understated-stats: Stat tiles use small, restrained values rather than hero numbers.
newLabels.new:unexplained-empty-gap: A large unexplained gap separates related elements.
newLabels.new:unlabelled-axis: A chart axis carries no value labels.
newLabels.new:washed-out-disabled-button: The disabled primary button is a faded, washed-out tint.
